csp.classification: Cloudflare's public edge injects an inline loader and static.cloudflareinsights.com beacon; Care Keeper's script-src 'self' policy intentionally blocks them. Axe-only diagnostics are browser qualification instrumentation.

notes: All 14 deployed screenshot, layout, and axe assertions completed before the original harness made one redundant final request.

That redundant request exposed write amplification in an initial reminder-source adapter and a transient SQLite session lock. The adapter was replaced with the final read-only reminder projection path.

The rebuilt final image then passed focused regression tests and a narrow deployed scan of Overview, History, sufficient Trends, Care, and insufficient Trends with zero application findings, page errors, or same-origin failures. The presentation markup and CSS covered by the completed axe scans did not change.
